scripts.build: npm run contracts:check && npm run build --workspace @prismatix/authoring-sdk
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test --workspace @prismatix/authoring-sdk && npm run test:package
scripts.test:package: node -e "import('@prismatix/authoring-sdk').then((sdk) => { if (typeof sdk.compileStory !== 'function' || typeof sdk.validateDocument !== 'function') process.exit(1); })"
